subject: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — Zephyrus Health
messages:
From: Cathy Liu <cathy.liu@zephyrushealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tim Jackson <tim.jackson@zephyrushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro for Zephyrus Health

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profiling you shared. We're ready to start the AWS co-sell (ACE) registration and would like to line up the AWS PDM/PSM intro as part of the intake.

High-level ask:
- Kick off ACE registration (we have a listing in-progress and want AWS co-sell support)
- Intro to your PDM/PSM so we can align on opportunity routing and target workloads
- Quick joint technical sync (30 min) to review integration requirements and readiness checklist

I've attached an intake PDF with the marketplace listing draft and an initial list of workloads. Also included is a first-pass mutual action plan we use internally.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue 16 Jul 11:00-11:30
- Wed 17 Jul 14:00-14:30

Please loop in whoever on your side manages ACE registration and PDM/PSM engagement.

Thanks,
Cathy Liu
Head of Partnerships
Zephyrus Health

Attachments: Zephyrus-ACE-Intake.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), Zephyrus-MAP-v1.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.inference>
To: Cathy Liu <cathy.liu@zephyrushealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro for Zephyrus Health

Hi Cathy — great to hear and thanks for the materials. Adding Karthik (sales lead), Marissa (PDM), and Naomi (partner ops) to coordinate ACE intake and the PDM/PSM intro.

Quick plan:
1) I'll triage the ACE intake and submit the registration packet to aws-ace@amazon.com this afternoon.
2) Marissa and Naomi will join the technical sync to confirm the listing-ready criteria and routing for co-sell.
3) We'll use the attached mutual action plan as the working doc and update timeline and owners in HubSpot — I pasted the HubSpot link below.

Proposed agenda for 30-min sync:
- 5m introductions (Redwood PDM/PSM + Zephyrus stakeholders)
- 10m marketplace & co-sell goals / eligibility check
- 10m technical requirements (auth, telemetry, minimal demo)
- 5m next steps & owners (MAP owners, AWS intake items)

I can take Tue 16 Jul 11:00 PST. If that works, Marissa — can you and Naomi join? If not, share windows and we'll pivot.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

Connor O'Brien
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.inference | +1 415-555-0142

---- Forwarded attachment stubs ----
Zephyrus-ACE-Intake.pdf (referenced)
Zephyrus-MAP-v1.xlsx (referenced)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>

Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 12 Jul 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: AWS ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro for Zephyrus Health

Connor / Marissa — I'll be on the sync. A couple of notes from a sales/ops perspective:
- Deal background: Zephyrus is targeting a pilot with 3 hospitals, estimated ARR if expanded ~$480k/year.
- Pricing band: likely mid-tier subscription+tokens; we should confirm packaging options during the call.
- Timeline expectation from Zephyrus: aim to have listing live and co-sell enabled by end of Q3 (Aug timeline) — aligns with their pilot start.

I'll bring a short one-pager summarizing value props and suggested routing for AWS (which SKU to recommend). Marissa — can you confirm whether we need a technical readiness checklist filled out before ACE acceptance?

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference
